preconditions.description: The input string must be non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of '(' and ')' characters.
The length of the input string must not exceed 10^6 characters.

postconditions.description: If no regular bracket sequence is found, the output must be '0 1'.
The output must contain the length of the longest regular bracket sequence and the number of such substrings.
